description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats log messages based on priority, tag, message, and throwable, and supports chaining of LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and throwable, and appends them to the view. Supports chaining to another LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data and appends it to the LogView. Converts priority to a string, processes throwable if present, and updates UI thread with the log message. Propagates the log to the next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the log view.
